Subject: Marketplace renewal + footprint expansion — phased capacity & billing playbook

Hi Ari / procurement team —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. StellarDocs is up for renewal in November and mentioned a likely 2–3x footprint increase driven by a new analytics feature that will hit production in Q1. We can support that growth via a Marketplace private offer that combines:

- A 12‑month commitment with a 6‑month phased capacity ramp (schedule attached)
- Split billing across two POs (Dev/Prod) to match your fiscal tranches
- EU VAT-ready invoice flow and evidence bundle for purchase ordering

I’ve attached a draft private offer (StellarDocs_Private_Offer_v3.pdf) and a simple SOW schedule outlining the phased capacity. High-level ask: can procurement review the PO template and confirm whether split POs + staggered invoice cadence will work for finance? If yes, we’ll route the private offer through AWS Marketplace and provide a DocuSign for signature.

Proposed near-term milestones:
1) Procurement confirms billing split and PO timing (this week)
2) Redwood finalizes private offer and provides DocuSign + HubSpot deal update (2 business days)
3) Marketplace acceptance & entitlement activation (up to 5 business days after signature)

I’m looping Jordan from Marketplace ops to confirm the acceptance timing. I’ll also pull in Kimberly for legal redlines if there’s anything material on the agreement.

Thanks —
Ben

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from procurement/ops:

- Split PO approach is acceptable, but finance needs the invoice cadence spelled out in the PO (dates and amounts per tranche). Can you include a table in the PO or SOW?
- We’ll need evidence for EU VAT (consumption location + invoice format). Will Redwood provide an evidence packet for the Marketplace acceptance window?
- Pricing looks reasonable in v3; can you confirm whether the committed pricing applies to burst usage during the first 90 days after activation? We may run an ingest-heavy pilot.

If you can answer those three, procurement can circulate the PO to CFO and legal for signature. We prefer DocuSign routing to a single point of contact (procurement@stellardocs.com).

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Platform Operations — StellarDocs

- Invoice cadence: see SOW_capacity_schedule.xlsx (attached) — we’ve defined three invoice tranches aligned to your fiscal quarters with exact GBP/EUR amounts (we’ll invoice USD but can include currency references). If procurement wants the amounts embedded directly in the PO text instead of the SOW, we can do that.

- EU VAT evidence: Redwood will provide an acceptance evidence bundle (invoice samples, entitlement confirmations, and a short consumption statement) as part of the marketplace acceptance package. I’ve flagged the evidence for Jordan to confirm delivery timeline.

- Burst handling: committed pricing applies to baseline committed capacity. Burst above that is billed at overage rates in the private offer; however, for the first 90 days we can apply a temporary uplift protection cap (capped overage at +15% effective rate) to give you runway for the pilot. We can add that clause to the private offer as an addendum.

Kimberly — I’ve attached the current private offer PDF (v3). If legal has anything material to flag, please mark up and we’ll iterate.

Next steps I propose:
- Procurement confirms PO routing (procurement@stellardocs.com) and whether they want amounts in PO or SOW
- Redwood posts final private offer to DocuSign and HubSpot (target: 48 hours after confirmation)
- Marketplace entitlement activation plan (Jordan to confirm acceptance SLA)

Thanks —
Ben

Hi all — quick ops note from the marketplace side.

We can accept the private offer and activate entitlements once DocuSign is complete. Typical acceptance path for AWS Marketplace private offers:
1) Signed private offer returned to Redwood (DocuSign)
2) Redwood posts offer to AWS Marketplace admin console (same day if signed before 2pm PT)
3) AWS acceptance usually completes within 24–72 hours depending on taxonomy and VAT checks
4) Entitlement events generated and we push activation to your account

EU VAT evidence: we’ll attach the acceptance bundle to the marketplace submission. For StellarDocs specifically, Jordan confirms we can package the invoice samples + entitlement confirmation PDF.

DocuSign: I’ll prepare the envelope and route it to procurement@stellardocs.com and cc your legal contact if you provide one. Internal note: Monica — please confirm whether we should include a second signature for the dev PO or route both POs to the same signer.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Partner & Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
